name: Lucy Altidore
source: Lucy is a young, friendly, and somewhat kinky dancer from the Lady Luck Club. She came to Dale from Europe in search of a better life. Lucy respects Adele and her co-workers but still dreams of leaving her stripper career one day to pursue her dreams and fulfill her ambitions.
